body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.53 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'other', n=16); SAC +3.6 pts x weight 0.259 (N=7) -> p = 0.54. Resolution: YES if the Q4 FY27 call/presentation (or NSE filings) states new orders/peak-annual business won after the Q2FY27 call and by 31-Mar-2027 totalling >=INR 450 cr (company's own figure; lifetime vs annual basis as the company states it, judged against the ~500 cr statement).
